reviews.text: Absolutely love this cushion foundation, I originally bought the mini keychain version of this and I used it so fast that I decided on getting the full size of this as well and I love it it’s so smooth and buildable while also feeling light and not smothering the way other foundations can be. I originally tried the Cleo kill cushion but it was just not working for me formula wise so I decided to try this because people said it was good for oily and dryish skin type and I love this formula way more.
reviews.zh: 超級鍾意呢款氣墊粉底，我本來買咗佢嘅迷你鎖匙扣版本，點知用得太快，於是決定入手正常裝，一樣咁鍾意。佢好滑，可以逐層疊加，同時感覺輕盈，唔會好似其他粉底咁焗住塊面。我本來試過 Cleo kill 氣墊，但係個配方真係唔啱我用，所以轉咗試呢款，因為好多人話佢啱油性同偏乾嘅膚質用，我鍾意呢個配方多好多。

reviews.text:
I have never really worn foundation before. Any time I have tried in the past it has always come out badly so I didn't bother. But my skin has gotten very patchy, red, and scarred so I wanted to give one a try and I saw this recommended on YouTube.
I am shocked by how well it worked. It just glides on with the puff and provides great coverage. It actually creates a light, even base. The cushion has a tip on it as well which I used to apply extra to the really bad areas and it actually covered them!
And it was all still there at the end of the day. I'm amazed!

I haven't tried any other foundations, I must admit, but I don't feel the need too. I'm happy!
reviews.zh:
我之前真係從來都冇用過粉底。以前每次試都搞到好差，所以索性唔理。但係我塊面變到好一撻撻、又紅又多疤，所以想再試多次，喺 YouTube 見到有人推薦呢款。

佢嘅效果令我好震驚。用粉撲一抹就滑上嚟，遮瑕力好強。佢真係可以做到一個輕薄、均勻嘅底妝。氣墊上面有個尖頭，可以用嚟重點遮嗰啲比較嚴重嘅位，遮得到！

到一日完結都仲 keep 得住。我覺得好神奇！

我要承認，我未試過其他粉底，但係我覺得冇需要。我好滿意！

reviews.text: The color is a light yellow base so it easily hides red splotches on my skin. It’s slightly more pale than other no. 21 cushions I’ve used. It applies very smoothly but becomes matte after some time. It applies very thinly and leaves your skin with a light sheen. After time, it does get a bit patchy around the mouth and nose area, and the color does get a little dark over time. It does a good job of blurring out small acne scars and pores.
reviews.zh: 顏色係偏黃嘅底色，所以好容易遮到我塊面嘅紅印。比起我用過嘅其他 21 號色氣墊，呢款稍為白淨啲。上妝好順滑，但係過一段時間就會變霧面。佢上得好薄，皮膚會留有少少光澤。過一段時間之後，嘴同鼻嘅位會有少少浮粉，顏色亦會隨住時間變得稍為深咗。遮細啲嘅暗瘡疤同毛孔嘅效果就幾好。

reviews.text: I would say it’s not bad, but not my favorite. I still prefer the new founware cushion (the black one). This one has a lighter coverage than the black one. Also it is not quite as thin, it seems to sit on top of the skin more than the black one and it seems a little harder to blend. It’s possible I’m just using too much. It might work better for someone who wants very light coverage and uses a very thin layer.
reviews.zh: 我會話佢唔差，但就唔係我最鍾意。我仲係比較鍾意新嘅 founware 氣墊（黑色嗰隻）。呢款嘅遮瑕度比黑色嗰隻低。而且佢唔算特別薄，感覺比起黑色嗰隻更加浮喺皮膚表面，比較難推開。都有可能只係我用得太多。對想要超輕薄遮瑕同只係搽好薄一層嘅人嚟講，可能會啱用啲。

reviews.text: The mesh cushion from Clio is my favourite, but I wanted to try this one. I like how pretty and modern the new founwear cushion looks. The finish is less shiny, which suits me, but it is clinging to my dry patches after an hour or two… where I‘m oily or normal, this cushion is fine. Where I am dry, it is drying me out more, which makes my flaky skin more visible, unfortunately. I haven‘t tried the powder, but it looks super pretty and like it‘s going to last me a long time.
reviews.zh: Clio 嘅網面氣墊係我最鍾意嘅，但係想試下呢款。我鍾意新嘅 founwear 氣墊嘅外觀，又靚又現代。妝效冇咁光，啱我嘅需要，但係一兩個鐘之後就黐住我嘅乾燥位……喺油性或者中性嘅位置，呢款氣墊冇問題。喺乾燥位，就反而令我更加乾，搞到我啲甩皮更加明顯，可惜。我未試過個粉餅，但係睇落超靚，感覺可以用好耐。

reviews.text: It's really lightweight on my face !!! The coverage is light to medium (you need concealer for a darker spot) . After 4 hours, it starts to crease around my nose area, especially on my nose bridge even though I use face powder on top of the cushion. I got the shade 21C and it's a little light for my skin tone.
reviews.zh: 上面真係好輕！！遮瑕度係輕到中等（深色斑點要用遮瑕膏先得）。4個鐘之後，鼻子位開始摺紋，尤其係鼻樑，雖然我已經用咗碎粉定妝。我買咗21C，對我嘅膚色嚟講有少少太淺。

reviews.text: This cushion seems to be receiving a lot of mixed reviews, especially by the Korean Beauty Youtuber Community. I do think it's quite a bit different from their previous iterations of this cushion. The finish sits somewhere in between the glow mesh and the fixer cushion. The coverage is medium to buildable, applies thinly, and leaves a natural glow but it isn't overly dewy. I don't think it covers pores especially well and it's not super long lasting like the other versions of the founwear cushion, but I think it's less matte and more balanced to suit other skin types. I'm personally a fan, it's very natural and skinlike but offers coverage.
reviews.zh: 呢款氣墊嘅評價好兩極，尤其係韓妝YouTuber圈子入面。我自己覺得佢同之前幾代真係差好遠。妝效介乎於glow mesh同fixer cushion之間。遮瑕度係中等到可以疊加，搽上去薄薄嘅，完妝有自然光澤但又唔會太水潤。遮毛孔方面我覺得唔算好出色，持久度亦都唔及founwear其他版本，但就冇咁霧面、平衡啱多啲膚質。我自己係鍾意嘅，妝感好自然似自己塊皮膚，但同時有遮瑕度。

reviews.text: I really love this! I think it’s a unique cushion and very different from the Clio cushions. It’s definitely a step up. I prefer this more than the founwear. I have combination to oily skin type. The coverage is light to medium, but I was able to build it up to a fuller coverage whereas the founwear was medium to full. I find that application is easier and more adherent compared to the founwear where you have to be careful or else it will be patchy and uneven, and even cling to dry spots. The finish is skin-like and semi-matte but with powder, you can make it more matte, yet still natural. The founwear on the other hand, I find that the finish is beautiful but not skin-like. Durability is okay, I do find that it collapses in the skin beautifully but I have to give points to the founwear being more long lasting. The original also darkened(oxidized) after 5 hours of wear so be careful with that. I use a brightening powder to avoid it and I will try it with this cushion next time.

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
